metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the sentence to Anne, Two Gents at two, and the reckoning that set next week.

yesterday: You wrote Anne one sentence and left it on the desk.
You played Two Gents. Grecian Comedy was the Rose bill.
Monday Titus, not you. Tuesday the Shrew, you, and the reading at Dick's. Abel reads.
Wednesday the old Hamlet, you. Thursday Errors, you, rehearsal at nine. Friday the Shrew, not you. Saturday Errors, you.
Seven shillings was a license. Thirty-three shillings was Margery's stair. Edith's eight shillings is still owing till Lady Day. Supper tomorrow is at the Burbages'.
